title: Bound one-direction replacement of opposite owned MOVEs
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** This tests two owned rank-one moves on exact #7481, MOVE40538 from chart 549 to 559 and MOVE40556 in the reverse direction. Keep the original 12 left entrance rows, the right owner at entrance, and the three fixed right-side public ingresses. Even granting arbitrary within-side corrections, one transfer direction cannot reproduce both old first outward reads.

- Retaining 549→559 fails at ADD40557. Input `x1=1` zeros the complete left entrance bank while the old output increment on 173 is `1/2`.
- Retaining 559→549 fails at ADD40539. Input `x1=1, x18=−1/2, x142=1` zeros the right entrance bank and all three right ingresses while the old output increment on 613 is `1/2`.

Both omitted-ADD controls give zero. The independent literal replay also verifies the scalar dependencies, owner lifetimes, and 67 INIT plus one COPY guard in each trace. The gross before repairs is exactly 17 raw across 17 signed copies. One added rank-one call per copy consumes it. Changed external ingresses, earlier encodings, routes and interfaces remain open.

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, native #7481 at `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b` and signed caller #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. The refined scope is one fixed exchange window and two orientations. #7491 concerns terminal single-recipient transfers and #7492 concerns a different two-contraction endpoint repair. Here both fixed first outputs require communication from the other side.

## Reproduce

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12 and the standard library, run

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-opposite-owned-exchange-bound/replay.py
```

Expected `PASS_OPPOSITE_OWNED_EXCHANGE`. Both orientations exhausted their fixed scope within each 30-second replay cap. Direct and registered replays, exact committed bytes/modes and source history, official read-only Git-free export replay, and 27 local onboarding tests passed. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate commits.

## Credit

#7481/#7480/#7334 supply the exact native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, #7482 the exact reverse row routines, and #7500 the public exact input copies. #7491 and #7492 supply distinct fixed-bank precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

## Open next questions

Can one of the existing ingresses of 613, 611 or 1279 be re-encoded before its move and still restore its independent old value before the affected read? A concrete earlier encoding and its complete price are the first gates. The exact roles, clocks and bounded replay are in the package.
